watch_note: watch[] is NOT a blocklist: watched domains are never excluded from discovery/adapt. The blocklist is strictly evidence-based — a domain is blocked only on its OWN failing runs. Peers that merely share an apparent operator with a blocked domain (guilt-by-association, no run of their own) are recorded here for attention only. A watched domain graduates to entries[] only when it earns its own evidence run — a human decision.
